snippet.title: POG1 | The Making of a Legend | Official Long Trailer
snippet.description:
*Official Release:* 
November Friday 13th 2026, 4PM CET, Free on Colnago Youtube 

# POG1 - The Making of a Legend
Discover the story of *Tadej Pogačar* , the greatest cyclist of his generation.

Created in close collaboration with Tadej and *UAE Team Emirates-XRG* , this documentary goes beyond the victories to explore the person, the relationships, and the moments behind his extraordinary career.

Featuring exclusive interviews, personal stories, and never-before-seen perspectives, the film offers a deeper look at the life, talent, and mindset of a cycling champion.

## *Main Credits*
- *Directed by* : Filippo Barcatta
- *From an idea by* : Manolo Bertocchi, Filippo Barcatta
- *Written by* : Filippo Barcatta, Claudio Rossoni
- *Produced by* : Colnago Cultura

## *Technical and Production Credits*
- *Delegate Producer* : Giada Mazzoleni
- *Director of Photography* : Lucia Zheng
- *Additional Camera* : Giovanni Ferrari, Dino Gervasoni, Tom Grundy, Lorenzo Verdinelli, Alan Bucar Vuksic, Hamdi Zammit
- *Editor* : Claudio Rossoni, Filippo Barcatta
- *Assistant Editor* : Carlo Anelli
- *Sound* : Dino Gervasoni
- *Production Sound* : Dino Gervasoni, Giulio Pacchiana, James Waterhouse
- *Music* : Alessandro Baldessarri
- *Color Correction* : Claudio Rossoni
- *Rights Clearance Consultant* : Paguro Film
